title: Naturally Smoky German Sauerkraut Skillet
description: A flexitarian-friendly German dish featuring fermented sauerkraut, herbes-de-provence, and a smoky flavor, perfect for a quick and crunchy meal.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chopped sauerkraut, herbes-de-provence, smoked paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Cook the sauerkraut mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is heated through and starting to brown.
If using tofu, add it to the skillet and cook until it is lightly browned and crispy on the outside.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the skillet mixture for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the flavors have melded together and the sauerkraut is crispy.
Serve the smoky German sauerkraut skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
